text.tspan: Practice each bar separately, then connect 43–45 and aim the whole passage toward the low point at measure 46.
Measures 46–54: Long cadential drive to the end of the first half.
Practice 46–49, 50–52, and 53–54, then play 46–54 as one directed phrase toward the cadence.
Measures 55–63: Opening of the second half — dominant arpeggiation and return toward G minor.
Practice 55–59 and 60–63 separately, then join them without losing the long harmonic direction.
Measures 64–69: Establishment of the C-minor region and new sequential motion.
Practice 64–66 and 67–69, listening for the new tonal center rather than treating the notes as isolated patterns.
